chapter.p: The law of circumcision was reinstituted with Abraham before the time of Moses as a token of the covenant between God and His chosen people and the practice was incorporated into the Mosaic law. Moses therefore gave unto you circumcision (not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers) (John 6:5 RE). It is important to note that the law of circumcision is a traditional short-hand way to refer to the Law of Moses. See also ACCOUNTABILITY, AGE OF; CIRCUMCISION; LAW OF MOSES.
